## Checklist

- [ ] Commits are signed off (`git commit -s`) and conventional
- [ ] A changeset is included, or this change does not affect a published package
- [ ] New dependencies, if any, are justified in the commit body: stars, last
      release, maintenance, and Apache-2.0 compatibility
- [ ] Docs updated where behaviour changed
